data.value: Replace all settings with the ones in {0}? The current settings are kept in a backup next to settings.json, and changes not applied yet in this window are lost.

data.name: ConfirmResetAll
data.value: Reset every setting to how it was when CashGear Capture was installed? The language and the choice about crash reports stay; the current settings are kept in a backup next to settings.json. Presets, history and recordings aren't touched.
